title: Canonical machine-code grammar
statement: Given natural numbers $k,n$ and a bit string $r$, the canonical grammar reader first consumes a unary index smaller than $n+1$, then consumes a table for a machine with $n+1$ states and $k$ work tapes. It succeeds exactly when every bit left over is $1$, returning that remaining suffix; otherwise it fails.
hypotheses_covered: The input is a bit string
